integrity: Counts are supported by complete algebraic group-character formulas, Abel-theoretic identification with plane conics, incidence double counting, and an independent exact finite group enumerator. Priority can be affected by unindexed earlier literature.
scientific_limitations: Only geometric counts of smooth and reducible six-secant conics and trisecant incidences; no claim about the parameter-scheme structure, mutual conic intersections, or positive characteristic.
scientific_scope: Every smooth complex plane cubic with a flex origin, exact-order-nine points, and unmarked conics meeting the cubic at six distinct such points.
title: Six-secant conics and trisecants of exact-nine-torsion points on a plane cubic
